# Making worthwhile work possible

Sequence enabling work and delivery against explicit prerequisites, finite effort and changed demand. Compare only work order: a pinned sequence always replays the current demand, budget and estimates.

The landscape distinguishes completed work, reachable work and missing prerequisites. Reachable does not mean affordable. Tasks run once in order; a blocked or unaffordable step is skipped without spending effort and is never implicitly retried. Distinct needed services are counted without an invented value score.

Inspired by [John Cutler’s Can Do vs. Should Do](https://cutlefish.substack.com/p/tbm-1652-can-do-vs-should-do). The dependency graph and effort are illustrative, with current, changed and mixed demand scenarios.
